title: Initialize Next.js and repository quality gates
acceptance: Create App Router TypeScript project at repository root without overwriting harness
Tailwind, lint, typecheck, Vitest and Playwright runnable with committed npm lockfile
A first responsive page renders and GitHub Actions passes
test: npm run lint; npm run typecheck; npm run test; npm run build

title: Impeccable design discovery, sitemap and approved design tokens
acceptance: Document personas, screen sitemap and each page's content hierarchy
Show desktop/mobile wireframes and approve typography, spacing, color, forms and status semantics
Discover Pinterest references; record source and usage rights for any production image
Record explicit lead design approval before feature pages
test: Design critique checklist, screenshot comparison and lead signoff

title: TypeScript DTOs, REST contract and mock scenarios
acceptance: Type all MVP entities and API request/response envelopes
Provide pure mock adapters with delay, empty, error and permission-denied variants
Specify scheduler recurrence and job status transitions, agreed by lead
Contract-level unit tests distinguish mocks from persistence
test: npm run test; API contract review

title: Technician mobile flow and checklist content map
acceptance: Define assigned job → checklist → photos → confirmation → report journey
Design offline/error/draft/duplicate-submit behavior
Show touch-friendly small-screen wireframes, fields and evidence limits
Obtain visual direction approval before building
test: Technician walkthrough and accessibility checklist

title: Coordinator shell, route navigation and mock login
acceptance: Dashboard has meaningful overview and navigable sidebar, search entry and statuses
Simulated role selection is visibly labeled mock, not production login
Keyboard/mobile navigation and loading/empty/error states work
test: Playwright mock route and manual 375px/768px/1440px inspection

title: Customer, site, system and component registry screens
acceptance: Create/list/detail UI for customer → site → system → component with validated forms
Expose serial numbers, install date, warranty expiry and replacement history
Empty, invalid, slow, duplicate serial and error mocks handled without fake persisted success
test: Vitest form validations; Playwright simulated registry journey

title: Maintenance planner and dispatch mock experience
acceptance: Plan create/pause/resume/edit with date preview, mock jobs and clear recurrence text
Dispatch table filters status/date/technician; assignment state and conflicts visible
Demo warns scheduling is simulated until S2 service is linked
test: Component tests for state changes and accessibility; mocked dispatch journey

title: Technician mobile UI, checklist, photo and report mocks
acceptance: Mobile job list/detail, checklist with readings, notes, photo picker and customer confirmation
Submission handles missing mandatory inputs and retry without claiming actual upload
Report screen displays structured mock result and accessible image alternatives
test: Playwright mobile simulated completion and form errors

title: Frontend UX signoff and contract freeze
acceptance: Run joint coordinator and technician mock demo with all four members
Record Impeccable critique outcomes and responsive/accessibility gaps
Approve API/DTO baseline and explicitly record S2 handoff; no claim of backend completion
test: Evidence links to reviewed PRs, screenshots and accepted design decisions

title: Supabase schema, foreign keys, Auth roles, RLS and seed data
acceptance: Migrations for profiles, customers, sites, systems, components, plans, jobs, inspections, reports
Single workspace coordinator and technician RLS and storage policies tested with real user roles
Unique occurrence constraint and replacement history retained
Local seed and isolated reset documented
test: supabase db reset on local-only; SQL policy and constraint tests

title: Server session handling and role authorization
acceptance: Real sign-in and sign-out work with session-safe server checks
Only coordinator can manage global records; technician reads only assigned jobs
Denied actions return safe errors and no privileged keys reach client
test: Auth role matrix and session expiry tests

title: Registry CRUD APIs and validation
acceptance: Customer/site/system/component records persist with FK and validated input
Reject cross-object tampering, invalid serial and unauthorized technician writes
Replacement keeps historical component records; pagination and errors contract-compatible
test: API integration tests on isolated Supabase and negative cases

title: Maintenance plan APIs, edit/pause/resume rules
acceptance: Coordinator-only create/update/pause/resume, Zod validation and explicit business date handling
Changing a plan preserves completed history; assigned conflicts cannot be silently moved
Plan edits record schedule revision and expose pending conflict outcome
test: Plan state-transition and permission integration tests

title: Transactional 90-day maintenance scheduler
acceptance: Daily rolling 90-day generation is deterministic for anchor dates and selected timezone
Duplicate repeated and concurrent invocations prevented by DB unique constraint and atomic insert
Month-end/leap-year/paused/edited/assigned/completed scenarios pass
Manual generation requires coordinator; cron endpoint requires server secret
test: Pure date tests, SQL concurrency/replay tests and API denial tests

title: Dispatch job read, assignment and status APIs
acceptance: Coordinator can assign and reschedule permitted future jobs
Technician sees assigned subset only and cannot self-assign
State transitions and conflicting updates return correct error semantics
test: Cross-role job API integration tests

title: Inspection completion, private photo storage and service reports
acceptance: Assigned technician can save and submit structured checklist with readings, photo refs and confirmation
Image size/type/auth constraints enforced in private storage; one report per completed job
Duplicate submit idempotent, partial file failure recoverable, unauthorized retrieval denied
test: Real storage policy tests, report integrity tests and invalid upload cases

title: Independent backend verification and S2 gate
acceptance: All migrations recreate clean isolated database and all contractual API tests pass
Technician denial and scheduler concurrency evidence exists
Lead signs gate before mock adapters are switched to real services
test: Supabase local integration suite, SQL test proofs and audit report

title: Wire real authentication and role navigation
acceptance: Mock-role toggle removed from production; live sign-in/out and expired sessions work
Coordinator and technician routes enforce server checks and show meaningful errors
test: Playwright real staging auth and role denial

title: Wire registry screens to real CRUD and preserve UX
acceptance: Create and reload customer/site/system/components from persistent database
Warranty and replacement records render correctly on mobile and desktop
Live validation, loading and denied-request states replace mock-only messages
test: Registry integration Playwright and screenshot regression

title: Wire plans, scheduler preview and dispatch to real API
acceptance: Plan saves, 90-day generation, pause/resume, assignments and status persist across sessions
Preview uses same recurrence policy as backend and displays conflict outcomes
Repeated generation creates zero duplicates in the real backend
test: Live-plan and duplicate-playwright checks with isolated fixtures

title: Wire mobile technician completion and report retrieval
acceptance: Technician views only assigned jobs, submits checklist, photos and confirmation against real backend
Report survives refresh and coordinator can view it
Network failure, repeat click, inaccessible photo and validation messages behave safely
test: Real two-role E2E on phone viewport

title: Live dashboard and warranty visibility
acceptance: Upcoming/overdue visit counts derive from real scoped data, not placeholders
Warranty expiry indicator uses component records, not invented telemetry
Zero-results and stale-data feedback are useful
test: Live fixture counts and empty-state verification

title: End-to-end scheduler stress and migration rehearsal
acceptance: 90-day golden dates pass for month ends, leap years, pause/edit, repeated/concurrent calls
No duplicates or corrupt completed history; capture timings and SQL evidence
Rehearse database backup/export and migration on staging
test: Golden fixtures, concurrent-run integration tests and migration rehearsal

title: Cross-role Playwright journeys, user validation and UI polish
acceptance: End-to-end coordinator → technician → report scenario passes with real test accounts
Mobile, keyboard, contrast, responsive and Impeccable audits documented
Capture feedback from installers/technician/owners where available; separate observed from planned validation
test: Playwright, axe-style accessible checks and supervised user walkthrough

title: Vercel/Supabase staging and production release with rollback
acceptance: Confirm actual free-plan eligibility and Git owner compatibility before deployment
Preview uses mock/isolated staging data; production secrets only in server env and database migrated deliberately
Daily cron protected with secret and manual recovery procedure; smoke and rollback documented
test: Preview smoke, denied cron request, authorized cron call, live production smoke after approval

title: Final acceptance demo, documentation and release signoff
acceptance: All P0 acceptance scenarios pass against staging or explicitly documented release exceptions
Client/team demo and permissions evidence signed by lead and non-author reviewer
Backup, recovery, limits, known issues, demo fixture and owners documented; Jira sprint closed only after retro
test: Release checklist, actual production smoke and final walkthrough
